output.subject: Your capital call on 1 Dec 2026
output.body: Dear Thomas, Atlas Growth V will call €150,000 on 1 Dec 2026. You have €40,000 in cash with us, so €110,000 still needs to be covered. My proposal: bridge this for 3 months with a loan against your ETFs, at an assumed rate of 4.5% a year — about €1,238 in interest — so your ETFs stay invested. This would need a separate credit agreement. The Meridian distribution expected in February is not confirmed; if it comes later, the loan runs longer. If markets fall sharply you may need to add collateral. Tell me in the app if you would like to go ahead and I will call you to set it up. Best, Jonas
